question: When two causal regimes produce different public next-state consequences for the EXACT same public state/action input, can a single deterministic input-only weight program simultaneously preserve the original predictions and fit the new ones, absent any additional observable regime signal?
hypothesis: No. For paired distinct next-state targets y_old and y_new at identical publicly observable (s,a), every single-valued predictor has paired mean squared-error at least ||y_old-y_new||^2/(4*4). This bound is attained by the outcome midpoint; WSP161 strict protected anchors must refuse all contradictory new edits while preserving old byte-exact state, and conventional WSP160 continual or matched independent batch ridge cannot simultaneously beat the mathematical bound without new public information. This limits a class of static observable-input models; it does NOT falsify contextual/memory-based intelligence.

inputs.name: authored source-free exact public-input overlap conflicts
inputs.source: 8 distinct s0/s1/s2 corners times actions 0,1; public s3=0; old/new target law differs by constant fixed vector (0.4,-0.3,0.2,-0.1) on all identical inputs; 3 seeded order replicas, no CausalGym environment import

inputs.name: independent conventional control
inputs.source: Reuse frozen batch-ridge Gaussian elimination comparator from WSP160 test_direct_weights.py, not native RLS

frozen_design.split: 16 unique exact public state/action contexts per replica = 8 public 3D +/- corners with s3=0 times 2 actions. Old FIT: 6 repeats per identity (96), old VALID: 4 repeats/identity (64); new FIT: 6 repeats/identity (96), new VALID: 4 repeats/identity (64). VALID contains new rows but NOT novel inputs; all input identities exactly overlap old FIT. Seeds permute input ordering only, not distinct source families.
frozen_design.ordering: Single prereg-only SHA before new source/test/results. Old model sees only old public FIT; protect one witnessed anchor per unique identity; new source-free observations then supplied in preselected permutation; score old/new held outcomes at identical inputs. Never pass a family label to WSP models. A theoretical midpoint oracle may examine both targets only to certify information-theoretic lower bound, not as a prospective model.
frozen_design.data_budget: (96 old FIT+96 new FIT+64 old VALID+64 new VALID) synthetic public records per seed x3; exactly 0 original external CartPoleWind reset/step/do/ctf_do, zero private held-out source, no hidden model labels.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Pure stdlib Python, max 2048 WSP160 and WSP161 rows/model, 16 witnessed anchors rank<=8. Reuse WSP160 independent conventional batch control; fixed source-free single scoring per 3 seeds, exact candidate SHA final Linux+Windows complete root regression and independent G29; no paid API/GPU/new owner.
frozen_design.capacity: Existing WSP160 single-valued four-output 10-feature public predictor and WSP161 protected single residual; no new adaptive learner or separate regime bank in primary. Certificate uses only paired public records, no oracle allowed inside learner prediction. Theoretical midpoint is an EX-POST full-target oracle lower bound, not an eligible prospective baseline.
frozen_design.evaluator: Per 4 outputs and 16 identical public keys, certified irreducible paired MSE floor = mean over keys and outputs of (y_old-y_new)^2/4, RMSE its sqrt. Program common-target MSE for both old VALID+new VALID. Verify exact midpoint oracle equals floor; fully fitted same-data independent batch ridge, continuing WSP160 and unchanged protected WSP161 >= floor (numerical tolerance 1e-10). WSP161 refuses each 96 new contradictory public action transition with zero state/checkpoint drift. Report best possible old/new RMSE tradeoff, no false claims about other architectures.

controls: Mathematically optimal ex-post midpoint of conflicting labels (oracle certificate, not a deployable competitor)
Independent fully trained conventional ridge using identical old+new public FIT outcomes and same public fixed action feature basis (reuse existing WSP160 test comparator)
Ordinary continued RLS trained 96 old then 96 conflicting new public observations
WSP161 protected direct coefficient editor using all 16 witnessed exact public anchor identities; should refuse contradictions and not fake learning
Frozen old WSP160 predictor (no update), preserves old but fails changed outcomes
Negative no-conflict paired identical outcomes must produce bound exactly zero; missing public context, unequal keys, privileged fields must fail closed

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_OBSERVABILITY_FALSIFICATION_SUPPORTED iff for ALL three seeded order variants: 16 public identical contexts with nonzero conflicting outcomes, analytic floor RMSE > 0.10; independent midpoint matches floor within 1e-12, all deterministic input-only candidate joint RMSE >= floor -1e-10, WSP161 refuses all 96 new FIT with unchanged checkpoint byte-exact and old prediction drift zero, and source-free negative tests/mandatory exact final Linux+Windows root+NKR05/G29 PASS. No architectural or scientific superiority claimed, SCIENTIFIC_PASS always false.
classification_rules.mixed: Focused mathematical tests pass but final dual-platform complete regression/G29 unavailable -> engineering UNVERIFIED.
classification_rules.negative: Contradiction not detected or source-free test violates analytic bound/false source privilege admitted -> DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO and preserve the negative; do not tune after score.
classification_rules.invalid: Original external source first-use, access to a hidden regime/source identity as model input, old/new paired inputs not exact, unqualified source/custody, edited WSP161/160/159/CKAD, changed thresholds after observing outcomes.

future_gate: To overcome information-theoretic ambiguity, freeze separately a memory-conditioned public history or costly diagnostic intervention protocol and matched contextual baseline; prove observable regime evidence BEFORE claiming a causal state switch. Real source action requires independently qualified owner/actor virgin cohort and explicit lease, not the conditional CVH10 budget.
